name: ask-sales-v5-10-final-promotion-gate-preregistration-2026-07-27

eligible: A realistic sales-rep question with a complete, readable threaded answer from Rich, Mike, Rudy, Raul, or Madeline
The expected answer can be written from the source text without guessing at missing screenshots, audio, or private context
The prompt tests reusable knowledge, a natural follow-up, an exact relationship or qualifier, or an intentional passive-chatbot routing boundary
Every final source message ID has zero overlap with every earlier Ask Sales evaluation, development replay, and runtime artifact
excluded: Screenshot-only, attachment-only, peer-only, self-replied, joke, announcement, malformed, low-quality, or unresolved threads
Questions that would not realistically be asked of the passive Ask Sales chatbot
Pure live actions except the preregistered routing-control stratum
Questions requiring unavailable context or a current live-status lookup
Any source or wording used to design, tune, or development-test V5.10
selectionProtocol.authorityReview: Resolve exact decision scope, authority, and recency together. Rich normally controls Sales policy over Madeline for the same decision, while a newer Madeline answer may control a changed or narrower decision when the source supports it.
selectionProtocol.selectionOrder: Select, audit, label, and seal the complete set before executing V3 or V5.10. Runtime output must not affect inclusion, wording, labels, or source interpretation.
